summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi Chinese Internet 2x Daily ETF (WEBX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (Ticker: KWEB), which provides exposure to Chinese Internet companies. WEBX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
